objective: Preserve local trained accuracy while improving learned-tree coverage selection.

requirements.requirement: Retain all local trained predictions and each original child accuracy
requirements.result: 144/144 raw-input tree predictions, twelve 12/12 child batches, renamed case IDs, zero regular fallbacks.
Local accepted predictions 144/144 correct; exploratory transfer accepted precision 38/60 versus task-only 22/55.

requirements.requirement: Use unchanged learned experts and regular fallback for unsupported inputs
requirements.result: 294 bound-input replays, 33 supported regions, 90 exact transfer fallbacks, no relabeling or fitted new verdicts.

requirements.requirement: Avoid case-membership routing and stabilize known raw inputs
requirements.result: 144 content-cache hits; cache stores upstream evidence only, with instruction/image/model/prompt keys and no human labels or verdicts.

requirements.requirement: Verify missing evidence, conflicting experts, unknown tasks, budget limits and serialized artifacts
requirements.result: 62 unit/regression tests passed; all final experiment hashes rechecked.

limitations: Local preservation uses the pinned original upstream evidence, reused by content hash for known inputs.
Transfer is exploratory development evidence: 22/60 accepted predictions remain wrong and one transfer split regresses versus regular judging.
No universal coverage-correctness or fresh-extraction stability claim; deployment remains opt-in.
